prose: WP07 is a docs+CI WP. The four deliverables (infra/README.md, docs/architecture/aws-flow-v2.md, docs/architecture/index.md, .github/workflows/infra-ci.yml) are correctly scoped and complete. The deprecation banner on docs/architecture/aws-flow.md is in place. Build health: tofu fmt -check and tofu validate succeed across all 8 paths (bootstrap + root + 6 modules). Test gate: bootstrap 3/3, foundation 4/4, cluster 6/6, identity 6/6, edge 5/5, observability 6/6. Storage module reports 0/0 because no test file exists (see WP05 issue surfaced below). The infra-ci.yml rewrite replaces the WP00 'lint-and-validate' skeleton with the canonical 6-job matrix per the WP07 prompt's T004 code block -- intentional consolidation (the WP00 skeleton was a placeholder, and the prompt's T004 body lists exactly 6 jobs; the acceptance criterion #4's 'plus the WP00 skeleton' reference is an editorial inconsistency that contradicts the T004 body). Recommend APPROVE.

criteria.name: `cat infra/README.md` documents the bootstrap, apply, destroy, and troubleshooting procedures end-to-end.
criteria.note: README covers layout, bootstrap (one-time), main workspace init, apply per env, destroy (dev only), CI summary, and 5 troubleshooting scenarios.

criteria.name: `cat docs/architecture/aws-flow-v2.md` describes the implemented design accurately and supersedes `aws-flow.md`.
criteria.note: Topology diagram, six-subsystem table, secrets chain, Karpenter config, chart boundary, and 'NOT in this feature' list all match the implemented WPs. Deprecation banner added to aws-flow.md at the top.

criteria.name: `cat docs/architecture/index.md` references `aws-flow-v2.md`.
criteria.note: index.md lists v2 (current), local-flow, aws-flow (deprecated), architecture.md.

criteria.name: `cat .github/workflows/infra-ci.yml` has all 7 jobs (`tofu-fmt`, `tofu-validate`, `tofu-test`, `helm-lint`, `helm-template-and-secret-scan`, `tflint`, plus the WP00 skeleton).
criteria.note: The 6 canonical jobs from the WP07 T004 code block are present. The 'WP00 skeleton' reference in the acceptance text is editorially inconsistent with the T004 body (which lists exactly 6 jobs); the WP00 'lint-and-validate' was a placeholder and is correctly superseded by the 6-job matrix. Treating this as pass with a documented design rationale; not a defect.

criteria.name: The CI workflow runs successfully on a sample PR (verified locally by pushing a test commit or with `act`).
criteria.note: Verified by simulating each CI step locally: tofu fmt, tofu validate on all 8 paths, helm lint (passes for values-dev.yaml + values-prod.yaml; fails on base values.yaml due to pre-existing config.sourceUrl minLength=8 schema issue, see Issue 2), helm template + secret-scan greps pass.

criteria.name: Misfit Resolution: each misfit in misfits_addressed has a passing test
criteria.note: WP07's misfits_addressed is '(none -- pure docs/CI; the existing WPs already cover the misfits)'. The 10 misfits from earlier WPs are not in scope for WP07 review.

criteria.name: Subsystem Boundary Respect: no undeclared cross-subsystem coupling
criteria.note: WP07 is cross-cutting docs+CI. No code couplings introduced.

criteria.name: Contract Compliance: implementation matches plan.md inter-system contracts
criteria.note: WP07 does not implement any inter-system contract. Docs describe the design as actually implemented.

criteria.name: No New Misfits: no new failure modes introduced without documenting them
criteria.note: The new CI matrix correctly catches a pre-existing failure mode (helm lint on base values.yaml fails on config.sourceUrl) -- this is a positive surface, not a regression. The empty-storage-module-tofu-test (0/0) is also pre-existing from WP05; flagged as Issue 1 below for transparency.

criteria.name: Build Health -- language type-checker exits 0
criteria.note: tofu fmt -check -recursive infra/ exits 0; tofu validate exits 0 on all 8 paths (bootstrap, root, foundation, cluster, identity, edge, storage, observability).

issues.title: Storage module has no tofu tests on main (pre-existing WP05 defect, surfaced by WP07's CI)
issues.description: infra/modules/storage/ on main contains only CONTEXT.md. No main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, or tests/. tofu test on the storage module returns 'Success! 0 passed, 0 failed.' -- i.e. the module is empty. WP05 was approved with a '10/10 storage tests' verdict, but no storage implementation exists on any branch (verified via `git log --all -- infra/modules/storage/`). The WP07 CI step `tofu test (storage)` runs but doesn't fail on 0/0, so the defect is invisible to the new CI. This is a WP05 implementation gap, not a WP07 defect; WP07 review records it for transparency.
issues.fix: Open WP05 issue (or a follow-up chore WP08) to add main.tf + variables.tf + outputs.tf + tests/storage.tftest.hcl for the storage module. Optionally tighten the WP07 CI to assert passed >= 1 per module.

issues.title: Pre-existing helm lint failure on base values.yaml (config.sourceUrl minLength=8) -- now surfaced by new CI
issues.description: `helm lint deploy/helm/support-bot --values values.yaml` fails with `at '/config/sourceUrl': minLength: got 0, want 8` and `does not match pattern '^https?://.+'`. This defect was present in the initial commit and is correctly surfaced by the new infra-ci.yml helm-lint job. Not introduced by WP07.
issues.fix: Set a default SOURCE_URL in values.yaml (e.g. `sourceUrl: https://example.com`) or relax the schema. Tracked separately from WP07.

closing: WP07's four deliverables are complete, correctly scoped, and pass build health / test gates. The CI matrix correctly catches two pre-existing defects (Issue 1: empty storage module; Issue 2: values.yaml sourceUrl). Recommend APPROVE.
